body: Editorial product poster: one clear bottle of sparkling lemon drink surrounded by lemon slices, mint leaves and a curved splash of water frozen mid-air. High-speed photography, dark navy backdrop, crisp rim light and strong bottle silhouette. Keep the left third empty for copy. Only the splash and ingredients orbit the bottle; do not obscure its front. Unbranded bottle with no text. Portrait 4:5.

en.title: Frozen lemon splash advertisement
